senses.definition: simple past and past participle of meet
(obsolete) simple past and past participle of mete (to measure)

quotes.text:
Then Hector, Priam’s martial son, stepp’d forth, and met the ground,
With wise Ulysses, where the blows of combat must resound;

senses.definition: (obsolete, impersonal) To dream; to occur (to one) in a dream.

quotes.text: All night me met eke that I was at Kirke.
